ModMetaData.name: RimMandrake: Proximity Hatch
ModMetaData.author: mandrake
ModMetaData.description:
EGG_PROXIMITY_HATCH_TRIGGER_1, owner (2026-09-08, verbatim): "Still need to dev a trigger for eggs that hatch at you on proximity." Adds CompProperties_ProximityHatch, a generic engine comp any egg-laying mod can pair with vanilla CompProperties_Hatcher: instead of only ever hatching on its own timer, the egg also watches a def-configurable radius and forces an early hatch the moment a live pawn walks into range, with the hatchling immediately aggroed on whoever tripped it - an ambush/horror beat, not a nest you can walk past safely. Fully generalizable (RimMandrake tier): this mod does not know or care what creature or campaign an egg belongs to, only that the ThingDef also carries CompProperties_Hatcher. See RimMandrake.ProximityHatch.CompProximityHatch for the mechanism and why it reuses CompHatcher.Hatch() rather than re-implementing pawn generation.
Supersedes the LIVE_BIRTH_AND_HATCH_DEMO_1 dev demo's proof that CompHatcher can be triggered and driven programmatically (src/RimUtinni/BirthHatchDemo) - that demo stays in the repo per the mod_consolidation_map.csv R14 ruling (owner sitting 2026-09-08: retirement NOT approved that round, gated on this item), but nothing further needs it: this mod is the extraction.
